lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible; spacing is narrower in the anterior section of the torso and broadens significantly toward the posterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments on the mid-lateral torso are abbreviated, failing to reach the ventral fringe or the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of approximately 4-6 white spots is visible on the upper hind limb and posterior flank area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate spiral; projecting laterally and posteriorly from the frontal bone before recurving toward the medial plane at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between apical tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 10% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the orbits, distinct white spots on the lower mandible, and a prominent white-tipped dorsal mane extending from the neck to the rump.
